thread:
emma_l: Received EU DSAR asking for full erase (embeddings + chat). Legal placed short hold for a regulator inquiry. Hold ID H-HOLD-45. Need minimal custody-proof steps, no deletes until legal clears. @legal-team
dmitri: Got it. Quick plan: 1) freeze user writes 2) export snapshot list 3) create ephemeral HSM key 4) timebound custodian RBAC 5) rewrap + verify -> signed proof JSON 6) upload proof to priv-proofs and attach audit.
legal-team: Confirm identity proof; hold active ~72h. We need the proof and audit link.
ops-oncall: I can run ops. Approvers?
emma_l: Approvers: @keystore-admin + @dmitri. Limit perms to cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on ephemeral key.
keystore-admin: Approved. I will not grant keystore-owner. I'll prep ephemeral key and IAM binding when you give the go.
ops-oncall: Running commands now:
```
keystore list --user U777 > preops-list.txt
# create ephemeral key (HSM)
gcloud kms keys create ephemeral-hhold-45 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
# bind minimal IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-hhold-45 --member=serviceAccount:ops-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rewrap and verify
keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-45 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-hhold-45 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
keystore verify --snapshot=snap-eu-45 --proof-out=hhold-45-proof.json
aws s3 cp hhold-45-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/H-HOLD-45/
```
ops-oncall: Done. Rewrap & verify succeeded. Proof uploaded. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/h-hold-45-grant :lock:
emma_l: I reviewed proof, shared with Legal. Marked snapshot metadata `hold:H-HOLD-45`. No deletion performed.
dmitri: Follow-up: add a single-run automation for creating timebound custodial roles + proof schema (include key fingerprint + KMS version + signed timestamp).
sec-bot: Vault: H-HOLD-45 artifacts saved.
